comment:
Reset writes to the Sweep parameter (Sweep.cpp:144), so it drags the knob back to centre rather than overriding it internally. Anything else driving that parameter, including Rack's own parameter automation, is fighting it.

The reset button and the three CV jacks carry no lettering on the panel. The maker's tooltips name them Reset, Sweep CV, Resonance CV and Reset CV.

The manual says Reset 'returns the filter to its reset position' without saying that the reset position is the centre bypass, or that the knob moves.

Both halves of the sweep run 20Hz to 20000Hz, so the centre is the open end of both filters, not a crossover (Sweep.cpp:169-186).
